tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi chos skor blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ /bcu drug lang tsho mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin glegs bam can/ /gangs ri'i mdog can 'jam dpal rgyal gyur cig /mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu gcig pu/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i bdag med don/ /rtogs byed shes rab stsol mdzad 'jam dpal gyi/ /gdams pa rang gi ji tsam rtogs pa bri/ /'dir ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can skyed par byed pa la/ mchog tu gyur pa rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi chos skor rnams yin pa las/ 'dir 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig grub kyi man ngag 'chad pa la/ thog mar man ngag gi rnam gzhag khog phub pa dang / gnad du che ba'i man ngag 'ga' zhig gsal bar 'chad pa'o/ /dang po la bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / bshad bya gsung rab rnams thor bkod pa'o/ /dang po brgyud pa'i rim pa la/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon dze tā ris paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti'i sgeg pa'i rdo rje rjes su bzung tshul la sogs pa lo rgyus kyi yi ge rnying pa na gsal ba logs su 'byung ba gzhan yin la/ gzhan yang brgyud pa'i rnam grangs sangs rgyas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi kā ma pu ri lo ke sho ra'i gnas na bzhugs pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa/ a wa dhu gnyis med ti pa/ shar phyogs go bo ḍār sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta a nu pa ma dpe med 'tsho rak+ṣi ta/ shar phyogs bhaṃ ga lar sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta dpal 'dzin/ bhaṅga lar sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rgyal po'i bla ma dharmī ka chos 'byung zhi ba ra/ shar phyogs bha ren+d+ra sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta bik+ṣa rnam par grags pa'i lha ta de ba/

shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharma da chos 'bangs sa/ ba ren+dar sku 'khrungs pa'i dza gad+da la bhi bhu ta rnal 'byor zla ba tsan+d+ra/ de la chag lo dgra bcom nas rim par brgyud pa dang / yang 'dzam bu gling na yongs su grags pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā kā ra gup+ta zhes bya ba rgya gar lho phyogs i ḍa u shar bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs/ bhaṅga lar byon nas dge tshul mdzad/ ma ga dhar byon te/ so so ri pa rat+nā kā ra gup+ta sogs brten nas gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rig pa'i gnas lnga/ sde snod gsum/ khyad par rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ seng ges spyod pa'i yul du rgyal pos chom rkun khri phrag bcu gcig khrims mun du bcug pa'i smre sngags gsan nas/ de rnams bslu bar brtsams pas yul de 'od kyis khyab/ sbrul ser khra chen pos dbu la gdugs phub pa ltar byas pas rgyal po skrag nas chom rkun rnams btang / grong khyer bde ldan du bdog pa thams cad btang bas zad pa na/ lhung bzed nam mkha' la bzed pas bza' ba sna tshogs byung ba dag gis slong mo ba rnams tshim par byas/ ldeng ka can du thun bzhir thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe/ bslab pa gsum la nyes pa phra mos kyang ma gos pas ji ltar smon pa'i bden tshig 'grub/ o tan+ta pu rir tu k+ṣa'i dmag gi 'ur byung bas shar phyogs su byon pa'i tshe rgya dpe glang po che'i khal sum cu rtsa gnyis byung / 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs thugs dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ sh+lo ka 'bum phrag brgyad cu thugs la bzhugs/ mang du thos pa'i mthar son/ rdo rje gdan dang bi kā ma la shī la'i mkhan po mdzad de/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas lta bur bzhugs pas mtshan brjod par mi nus/ bi kā ma la shī la paṇ+ḍi ta zhes zer te/ 'dzam bu'i gling kun du grags/ ma ga dha'i rgyal po shing drwa can gyi gnas gzhi btsugs te phul bar bzhugs nas paṇ+ḍi ta kun gyi gtso bor rdo rje rnal 'byor rjes su gnang ba la brten nas gzhung sh+lo ka 'bum gcig brtsams/

de yang nyin mtshan gyi thun dang po la bstan bcos rtsom/ gnyis pa la bshad/ gsum pa la thugs dam mdzad/ rdo rje phreng ba'i mchod brjod brtsams pas lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab/ thugs dam gyi gtso bo 'jam dpal yin pas/ rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng du thog mar 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon rtogs mdzad pa yin no/ /man ngag snye ma brtsams pas he ru kas shis brjod mdzad/ dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi sgrub thabs sogs sgrub thabs mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa brtsams pas bsil ba tshal du bu gcig pa shi ba bslangs/ yid 'ong dge ba'i ldum rar chom rkun bcings/ rtsis 'bras kyis bram ze dbul po'i thab nas gter bton/ sngags kyi nus pas khyim bdag la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsal/ bya'i 'khrul 'khor gyi dmag dpung bzlog dza ya na ga rar/ grong khyer 'bum phrag bcu gnyis kyi me'i gnod pa zhi bar mdzad/ rgol ba ngan pa du ma tshar bcad/ dgung lo brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad nas/ bar dor gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku grub bo/ /de lta bu'i slob dpon a bhā ya kā ra nas brgyud pa'i bka' babs ni/ chag lo gsum pa'i bar te'u ra pa rnams la zur du brgyud pa'i rnam grangs kyang mang du snang mod/ 'di rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar ba mang du yod mod/ shes par 'dod na dpag bsam snye ma dang / 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus chag lo gsum pas mdzad pa rnams su blta'o/ /brgyud pa'i bka' babs gcig ni/ a dhā ya nas da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar sgrub thabs rgya mtsho ltar yin no/ /yang brgyud pa'i bka' babs gcig ni rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la brgyud pa sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar yin no/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa phal che ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs paṇa chen ma ti dang / /pan chen shāka shrī mkhan chen byang chub dpal/

/bde ba dpal dang sangs rgyas gzhon nu dang / /bsod nams shes rab mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ /shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen kun dga'i mtshan/ /rgyal tshab kun dbang rat+na war+dha dang / /dkon mchog lhun grub nam mkha' brang ti ba dpal bzang zhabs/ /nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal hor se chen rgyud bzang las/ /legs par thob pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs so/ /de ltar dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs yi dam lha'i tshogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lhar bcas/ /phyag 'os kun la yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sgrib sbyangs nas/ /yang dag blo gros snang ba bskyed du gsol/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa bshad bya gsung rab kyi rnam grangs thor bkod pa la/ da lta rjes gnang lung rgyun bzhugs pa ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam gnyis na yang 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig grub kyi sgrub thabs rgya gzhung bod gzhung rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 'dir zur bka' la thog mar paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung tshigs bcad ma/ kha che na paṇa chen shākya shrī dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba snub byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ de'i bstod pa don zab ma ma tis mdzad pa/ lo rgyus kyi yi ge rnying pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rnying pa rnams kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī phyag len ji lta ba bzhin lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis sdebs pa/ rgya ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ chag lo sum pas mdzad pa'i lo rgyus/ sgrub thabs/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum dang bcas pa/ brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa ste de rnams gal che ba'i yig cha rnams yin zhing 'di rnams deng sang bka' ma nub cing lung rgyun dang bcas pa bzhugs pas so/ /'dir thor bkod pa bzhin bsgrigs te gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs gyi chos skor da lta ma nub cing rang gi thob pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam byung na'ang ci ma rung snyam pa blo yul na snang mod/

'on kyang don gnyer dkon zhing / snyigs ma'i dus su song bas bstan 'gror e phan ma shes pas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag go /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa gnad du che ba'i man ngag 'ga' zhig 'chad pa ni/ bsnyen pa sgrub pa las sbyor dang gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa la/ gang gi nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag des ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i dgos pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs mnga' 'phags pa rin po ches/ tshul khrims byang sems dam tshig gsum/ /gzhi yin phyir na brtan par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dge bsnyen nas dge slong gi bar gyi so sor thar pa'i bslab bya rnams dang / dbu sems gnyis kyi sems bskyed cho ga las thob pa'am/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur rnams kyi skabs su'ang / smon 'jug sems bskyed re thob pas/ de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya rnams dang / gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang bka' rang gi ji ltar thob pa rnams kyi bsrung sdom shin tu brtan pa zhig dgos te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sdom pa gsum la gnas pa ni/ /dang po'i khrus su bshad de/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho gar mi ldan pa/ /sngags pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gyur te/ /thal ba las 'bras bskyed bzhin te/ /rtsa ba rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang sdom gsum cho gar rab tu brtag /de ltar sngags pa tshul ldan pas/ /ston pa sangs rgyas sogs mchod cing / /lha tshogs 'jig rten kun gyis bskur/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i steng du 'phags pa rin po ches/ byams dang snying rje smon pa gsum/ /sngon 'gro yin phyir sngon du bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dal 'byor gyi lus rten rnyed par dka' bsams pa/ de yang mi rtag ste myur du 'chi bar bsam pa/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes par bya ba rnams gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar zhib tu bsgom mo/

/'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ 'jig rten rnam rtog ma log pa'i/ /chos pa bzang yang srid rtse yin/ /zhes gsung / de ltar 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi pha mar thag chod nas/ 'di rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral bar bya de'i ched du bdag nyid kyis/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsgrubs te ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab thob par bya snyam pa zhe thag pa nas rgyud la skye ba cig dgos so/ /nyams su blang bya'i sgrub thabs ni/ sgrub thabs mang por yan lag bzhi rdzogs sogs spros pa du ma byung yang / 'dir paṇa chen nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'di ma ti'i rgya gzhung dang / rgya ston rin po ches mdzad pa dang / brgyud pa'i man ngag bcas 'khrul med yin pas 'di ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blang / 'di la ye shes pa gzhug pa dang rigs bdag bla ma bsgoms pa sogs ma byung ngo snyam pa'i rnam rtog mi bya ste/ 'dir ye shes chogs bsags kyi skabs su stong nyid spros bral bsgom nas/ de'i ngang las sgrub bya'i lha/ bla ma/ sgrub pa po rang gi sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug rnams dbyer med pa lha'i rnam par bsgom pa yin te/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ lha dang bla ma rang rig gsum/ /dngos bzhi yin phyir mnyam par bzhag /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar nges par byas nas/ bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i dus gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzoms pa'i yar ngo sogs dus bzang gcig la byed/ dben pa'i gnas su gtsang sbra phyag bdar sogs byas te/ spyi dang bye brag gi rten yod na bsham/ de'i mdun du dkar gtor gcig chu gnyis nyer mchod dang bcas pa bsham/ sgrub pa po'i stan nang 'tshang can byung na kha shar du phyogs par bya/ nub dang po la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par dmigs la/

bdag gi sgrub pa mthar phyin par mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i gsol ba drag tu btab/ dkar phyogs rnams la 'phrin bcol dang / bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam la cha gsum yid ches nges shes pa gcig btang na legs gsung / gdan khar bsdad ma thag gong du bshad pa'i dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs nges 'byung gi bsam pa gsal btab/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang / khyad par rang gang la mos pa'i bla ma la bla ma chos 'brel yod tshad bsdus la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab/ 'di dag gi skabs su byung na theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blang / de ma byung yang sha chang sgog tsong sogs spangs te bdor dkar bya/ chab len pa dang khrus dang gtsang sbra gang che bya/ skyabs 'gro'i skabs su skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs zhing khams rnam par dag pa bsam pa'i mdun dpag bsam sdong po lo ma me tog 'bras bus spud pa'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyer med la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams zhal nang du phyogs pas bskor ba dang / shar du yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ lhor sangs rgyas longs sprul rnams/ rgyab tu theg pa che chung gi chos pu ti brag ri brtsigs pa lta bu/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha rnams bzhugs par bsgoms/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan rang dang ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad/ rang gis skyabs 'gro byed pa bzhin/ 'di phyi bar do/ /sangs rgyas ma thob bar du re sa skyabs mgon gzhan na med par mgo bcad pang bskyur gyi tshul du snying thag pa nas skyabs 'gro ci nus bya ste/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ dkon mchog gsum la mi ltos pa'i/ /gang zag bzang yang mu stegs yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan sgrub thabs kyi tshig don rnams ji lta ba bzhin bsam pa las gzhan sbyar rgyu med/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i skabs su/ sems ma yengs pa gal che zhing / dmigs pa gcig pus sems skyo na/

res lha'i sku'i cha shas la sems gtad/ res sngags kyi sgra la sems gtad/ res sems kyi gnas lugs brjod bral du shes pa'i sgo nas sems rtog med sgo nas bzlas pa bya/ mdor na sems tha mal rnam rtog gi dbang du ma song ba zhig gal che rgyu yin/ 'di sgrub thabs tshig tshogs nyung bas thun bzhi bya/ thun 'tshams rnams su gtor ma 'bul te gtor mgron rgyas pa byed na mdun gyi nam mkhar waṃ las rgya mtsho sogs nas/ skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'i bar bya/ bsdu na rang gi snyi kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun 'jam dpal la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba gtor ma'i steng gi nang gi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyi gdan phul la gtor ma sgrub thabs bzhin phul/ dmigs rten yod na bskyed pa dang spyan 'dren gang yin kyang de dang dbyer med du bsam/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum phrag gsum dang zhag bdun la sogs pa byed pa'i srol snang ste/ 'di ni sngon du bsnyen pa rgyas par song nas rjes sor kha bskong lta bu byed na legs pa yin/ rgyud du sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga yi ge 'bum bzlas na sngags kyi rgyal po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'bru 'bum ste/ 'bum phrag drug bzla ba ni grangs bsnyen no/ /yang paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis/ zla ba gcig gis blo 'phel rig pa 'dzin/ /zhes gsung / a bhā yas ni/ 'bum phrag bdun bshad/ deng sang phyag len phal cher zla gcig po la mdzad/ de nas lan lnga bskyar na zla ba drug tu 'gro/ de rnams la 'bum phrag bzhi bcu 'gro ba ni/ rgyud las/ zla ba drug gi man ngag gis/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub par byed/ /ces sogs gsung pas/ rtags ni mngon sum mam/ nyams/ rmi lam du bcom ldan 'das dngos su mjal ba/ gsung thos pa/ bstan bcos rnams mngon du 'gyur zhing / mi brjed pa'i gzungs dang thos pa 'dzin pa/

gzhon nu gos dkar can gyis pu ti dang / mtshon cha dang / shel phreng / 'o thug ster ba/ nyi zla shar ba/ sgron me sbar ba/ dar 'phyar/ rol mo 'bud dkrol/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ khrus byed pa/ chu bo brgal ba/ lus las me 'bar ba/ gos dkar po gyon pa/ chu bo'i rgyun 'thung ba sogs rmi'o/ /dngos su lce bde ba/ ngag snyan/ dran pa gsal ba sogs 'byung ngo / /snyigs ma'i dus kyi dbang gis mtshan ma sogs ma snyed na'ang bsnyen sgrub yang yang bskyar ba dang / yi chad log lta mi byed par/ sgyid lug spangs te/ nyams len 'dor len mi byed par/ skye ba dang tshe rabs su nyams len 'di las mi g.yo ba'i zhe dam bya/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis byams pa sgrub pa la sogs pa'i grub thob rnams kyi rnam thar bsam/ thun mtshams rnams su tsan+dan dkar dmar byug pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa bsham ste/ mdun du 'jam dpal bsgoms la gus btud dang bcas pas/ rang gi mdun du nas 'bras sogs me tog dkar pos bkang ba'i snod bzhag ste tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ ngag tu/ 'dzam bu'i gling ngam gling gzhan rnams/ /nor bu rin chen gyis bskangs te/ /stong gsum la sogs ma lus pa/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /zhes maṇ+ḍal ci rigs par 'bul/ mtshan brjod la 'bad/ bstod pa rgyas pas bstod/ bdag la shes rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol snyam pa'i gsol ba rtse gcig btab bo/ /de yang 'phags pa rin po ches/ /sgyu ma stong nyid zung 'jug gsum/ /khyab byed yin pas kun rgyas gdab/ /ces dang / bsngo ba smon lam lam khyer gsum/ /mjug sdud yin pas mjug tu bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nyams len thams cad gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang / lta ba spros bral zung 'jug gi rgyas 'debs pa dang / 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /gsum pa nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu ni/

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa la dmigs pa nyid do/ /zhes 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi chos skor blo kha 'byed ces bya ba las sngon du bsnyen pa sogs kyi lag len khrigs chags du bkod pa 'di ni mi dbang rdo rje 'dzin pa sa skyong bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs kyis bskul zhing thugs dam gyi ched du chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis chos grwa chen po lhun grub steng du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa'i shes rab lhun grub kyis bgyis pa'o// //shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza gat+taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi chos skor blo gros pad+ma kha 'byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
